name: single

source: feature calt { sub a by b; } calt;

name: nested
source: lookup X { sub a by b; } X; feature calt { sub a' lookup X c; } calt;

name: failed_nested

name: restored

name: ignore
source: feature calt { ignore sub a' b; sub a' by c; } calt;

name: boundary
source: lookup X { sub a by b; } X; feature calt { sub a' lookup X c; } calt;
